_meta.purpose: Per-group dropdown values for component fields. Each group is self-contained — same field value lists may appear in multiple groups. Each entry has 'short' (stored value) and 'long' (display description). Code fields (Matl_Code / Bolt_Matl_Code / Nut_Matl_Code) carry an additional 'std' key so the dialog filters them by the matching std selection. Matl_Code entries additionally carry a 'category' key (CS / LTCS / AS / SS / DSS / SDSS / Ni-Alloy / Cu-Alloy / GI / CI) so the dialog and validator enforce Matl_Category ↔ Matl_Code consistency.
